title: The Door the Plaza Walks Around
description: Scriptura's plaza, seen by a Rogue lead. Four citizens point at the bookshop without looking at it; the Rogue sees the second thing. Her line, said once, over the live plaza.

lines.speaker: Rogue
lines.text: There. The small door the whole plaza's walking around. Four people gave me directions to it and not one of them looked at it. That's not a shop nobody knows — that's a shop everybody's decided not to mention.
